title: the cost of ONE transaction unwind on the duplicate logout path
method: The duplicate path is reproduced in the database: the staged insert is made inside a SAVEPOINT (begin_nested), the flush raises the unique violation, the savepoint rolls ITSELF back, and only then is the outer unwind timed. The exception is classified with the production predicate (_is_duplicate_blacklist_violation), so the arm can only be the duplicate branch. The savepoint's own rollback is NOT inside the timed region: the clock starts after it. No HTTP request is issued and the app's lifespan is not run.

protocol.statistic: min-of-N with the median and the max reported beside it
protocol.criterion: report only; this is not a new < old comparison and no improvement is claimed

duplicate_path_unwind.what: the outer unwind on the duplicate logout path - the exact call and the exact state the redundant ROLLBACK S-2 removed ran in

unwind_with_a_flushed_insert_to_undo.what: one unwind that has real work to undo, for scale

local_floor.what: one unwind with no transaction open - the local floor of the call

the_figure.numerator_is: the min-of-N cost of ONE transaction unwind on the duplicate logout path

denominators.uncontended_floor_source: GATE B's named floor; the committed corroboration is perf-results/RESULT-20261012-sweepB/sweepA_8_stats.csv (min 4.09577600294142 ms at concurrency 8)

the_figure.endpoint_the_saving_lands_on: POST /api/v1/account/logout, on the REPEAT (duplicate-token) path only. A normal logout never took this branch, so the saving lands on a repeat logout and on nothing else. It does not land on GET /users/me or on any other request path.

what_is_not_asserted.no_new_less_old: No comparison of a before arm against an after arm is made. There is no before arm here: the line S-2 removed is gone from the tree, so what this measures is the cost of the unwind as it would have been executed, not a measured saving.
what_is_not_asserted.no_endpoint_measurement: no HTTP request is issued and the lifespan is not run
what_is_not_asserted.not_the_cost_of_a_logout: it is the cost of ONE unwind, on one branch
what_is_not_asserted.the_denominator_is_not_re_measured: EM-6's logout p50 and the 4.09 ms floor are quoted from the committed record; neither is re-measured here, and the floor is not substituted with a warm p50
what_is_not_asserted.main_json_stub_never_compared: tests/benchmarks/baselines/main.json is a stub and is never compared
